name: Being Effective
overview: Scripture teaches that being effective in the Christian life involves humility, reverence for God, and turning away from evil, as Proverbs 3:7 instructs believers not to be wise in their own eyes but to fear the Lord. Effectiveness also requires understanding the nature of temptation, recognizing that God does not tempt anyone to do evil, as James 1:13 clarifies. Additionally, the power of earnest, righteous prayer is emphasized in James 5:16, showing that confessing faults and praying fervently for one another brings healing and accomplishes much in the life of the believer.
